reasoning_steps: The text introduces new processes and specific amino acids used for medical purposes, requiring the addition of new classes to cover these concepts.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An AminoAcidSynthesisProcess is a Process that involves the chemical reactions necessary to produce an amino acid from precursor molecules.
classes.comment: This class covers various synthetic pathways for amino acids.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A CyanideAdditionReaction is a Process that involves the addition of cyanide to an aldimine, resulting in the formation of amino acids.
classes.comment: This reaction is part of the Gabriel synthesis method.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A PhthalimideSynthesisProcess is a Process that involves treating an alpha halogenated acid ester with potassium phthalimide to produce substituted phthalimides, which are then hydrolyzed to yield amino acids.
classes.comment: This process is used in the preparation of certain amino acids.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A NonStandardAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that does not conform to the standard set of 20 amino acids used in protein synthesis but has specific medical applications.
classes.comment: This class includes non-standard amino acids like D-Penicillamine.

classes.aristotelian_definition: DPenicillamine is a NonStandardAminoAcid that acts as a chelating agent and is used in the treatment of Wilson's disease.
classes.comment: It is a metabolite of penicillin with specific medical applications.

classes.aristotelian_definition: N-Acetylcysteine is a NonStandardAminoAcid that functions as an antioxidant and is used in the treatment of cystic fibrosis and chronic renal insufficiency.
classes.comment: It has various medical applications beyond amino acid synthesis.

classes.aristotelian_definition: Gabapentin is a NonStandardAminoAcid that acts as an anticonvulsant and is used in the treatment of epilepsy.
classes.comment: It has specific medical uses unrelated to protein synthesis.
